The image depicts a three-seater sofa. This sofa is of a rectangular shape and has a simplistic design. It features three separate seat cushions, arranged in a row on the right side of the image. Each cushion appears thick and comfortable, ensuring the sofa's functionality as a piece of furniture meant for sitting.

The backrest is relatively high, extending vertically upwards and then curving slightly to integrate with the arms of the sofa. This design provides back support, which is essential
